text: 你把武器转向阿米莉娅，大致对准她，逼问她把这一切解释清楚。
她开始哭泣，眼泪弄花了妆。她试着开口，却结结巴巴地说不出话，直到你威吓着朝她走近一步。她再次畏缩起来，开始脱口说出脑中第一个想到的事情。
“是约书亚！是他指使那个警察的！他、他保护我。他爱我……”她说着说着没了声音，瘫倒在地，哭成一团。
她此刻情绪太激动，无法再给你任何帮助。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 99
text: You turn your weapon in Amelia’s general direction and demand that she explain the meaning of everything.

She begins to cry, the tears smearing her makeup. She tries to speak but ends up stuttering and stammering until you menacingly take a step in her direction. She cowers once more and begins blurting out the first thing that comes to mind.
“It was Joshua! He put the policeman up to it! H-he protects me. He loves me…” She trails off and falls to the floor in a weeping mess.
She is too upset to be of any further use to you at the moment.
